# binjgb

The Game Boy (Color) emulator the website plays the ROM in, compiled to
WebAssembly: `binjgb.js` and `binjgb.wasm` from `docs/` of
[binji/binjgb](https://github.com/binji/binjgb) at commit
`16621111ed0ee73bcc45c912a823bcebedcffc0f` (2026-09-25), unchanged.
MIT license, see `LICENSE`.

| `binjgb.wasm` | `52c165069441a09180b4bd63464318aa7b861b1d36e0d05e8047b48619fd2f0b` |

`web/app.js` drives it the way binjgb's `docs/simple.js` does.
